# Steps `dev/ci_contract.py` permits to name a tool, and the reason each does.
#
# An entry is `workflow.yml:Step name`. Every line is a debt with an owner, not
# a dispensation: the file exists so the unconverted surface is a number
# someone can burn down instead of a silence.
#
# THE GROUPS BELOW ARE THE BURNDOWN ORDER, cheapest and most duplicated first.

# --- runner-plane - belongs to ci-fleet ----------------------------------------
# `Fail fast on a lane no online runner can serve` is the one that matters:
# it is `dev.ci.runner_queue_watchdog`, this repository's own third
# implementation of a check ci-fleet OWNS as `runners/ci/preflight.sh`.
# vaultspec-rag and vaultspec-dashboard carry the rendered copy with its
# BEGIN/END markers; vaultspec-core hand-wrote a fourth. Replacing all of them
# with the render is the single largest de-duplication left in the fleet.
# `Verify assumed runner capabilities` is likewise a fleet fact, and
# vaultspec-dashboard has a whole workflow (ci-runner-probe.yml) asserting the
# same things a different way.
packaging-homebrew.yml:Fail fast on a lane no online runner can serve
packaging-quick.yml:Fail fast on a lane no online runner can serve
packaging-scoop.yml:Fail fast on a lane no online runner can serve
packaging-smoke.yml:Fail fast on a lane no online runner can serve
publish.yml:Fail fast on a lane no online runner can serve
runner-fleet-health.yml:Fail fast on a lane no online runner can serve
runner-fleet-health.yml:Verify assumed runner capabilities
runner-fleet-health.yml:Reclaim build space

# --- CI-plane bookkeeping ------------------------------------------------------
# Reads and writes GitHub state through `gh` or the release automation, and
# has no local meaning; `gh` is already permitted and these differ only in
# reaching it through a shell conditional.
docs-publish.yml:Require the deploy role before anything else
docs-publish.yml:Alert on failure without touching the release
release-please.yml:Regenerate and push uv.lock onto the release branch
release-please.yml:Open a reconciling pull request when the lockfile drifted
release-please.yml:Dispatch the publish workflow
release-please.yml:Dispatch the documentation publish workflow
release-please.yml:Refuse a deadlocked release state

# --- pending - a gate with no recipe -------------------------------------------
# Each is a real gate that a contributor cannot run before pushing.
#   check-semgrep          `uvx --from semgrep==1.168.0 ...`, twice, with the
#                          version pinned in YAML rather than in the toolchain
#   check-vault            `vaultspec-core vault check all`, called raw; every
#                          other repo in the fleet reaches the vault by recipe
#   check-dependency-vulnerabilities  ci-full exports the lock and pipes it to `pip-audit`
#                          while `just check-dependency-vulnerabilities` runs the fleet's own
#                          dependency_audit.py - two different answers to one
#                          question, in one repository
#   test-roundtrip         a four-path pytest invocation with a `-k` filter
#   test-live-drift        the GROI live-drift suite, named by path
aeat-drift-detector.yml:Run GROI live drift tests
agent-harness-eval.yml:Cadrumo agent-harness eval surface
ci-full.yml:Semgrep regression rules (linkage-design type-uniformity)
ci-full.yml:Audit dependencies for known CVEs
ci-full.yml:Vault structural drift (informational)
ci-full.yml:Ledger + storage roundtrip suite
ci.yml:Semgrep regression rules (linkage-design type-uniformity)
docs-publish.yml:Publish the documentation site

# --- pending - the packaging and release lanes ---------------------------------
# ~700 lines of bash and pwsh across four workflows, none of it runnable by a
# developer. `just test-packaging-portable`, `just build-packaging-cohort` and
# `just test-python-compatibility` already exist and cover parts of this, which
# is what makes the rest visible as duplication rather than as necessary
# scaffolding: python-runtime-compatibility.yml re-implements the compatibility
# recipe wholesale, and packaging-smoke.yml's Linux leg inlines a campaign its
# own Windows and macOS legs invoke as `just test-packaging-portable`.
#
# Recipes needed: `release-publish-pypi`, `packaging-evidence`,
# `test-channel-homebrew`, `test-channel-scoop`, plus calling the three that
# already exist from the workflows that re-implement them.
packaging-homebrew.yml:Initialize current-run evidence root
packaging-homebrew.yml:Verify declared Homebrew release row
packaging-homebrew.yml:Verify source workflow identity
packaging-homebrew.yml:Verify and generate the cohort-bound tap snapshot
packaging-homebrew.yml:Audit install and exercise Cadrumo through Homebrew
packaging-homebrew.yml:Emit the sanctioned Homebrew distribution-evidence record
packaging-homebrew.yml:Stage build-failure diagnostics
packaging-homebrew.yml:Clean up the retained Homebrew install
packaging-homebrew.yml:Stage the Homebrew evidence bundle
packaging-scoop.yml:Initialize current-run evidence root
packaging-scoop.yml:Verify declared Windows native release row
packaging-scoop.yml:Verify source workflow identity
packaging-scoop.yml:Generate cohort-bound Scoop source manifest
packaging-scoop.yml:Stage token-free smoke harness
packaging-scoop.yml:Install and exercise Cadrumo in the lane user's Scoop profile
packaging-scoop.yml:Verify the smoke evidence binds to this run
packaging-scoop.yml:Emit the sanctioned Scoop distribution-evidence record
packaging-scoop.yml:Stage the Scoop acquisition bundle
packaging-smoke.yml:Cadrumo immutable-cohort packaging campaign
packaging-smoke.yml:Checkpoint packaging evidence
packaging-smoke.yml:Archive the tested Cadrumo Python cohort
packaging-smoke.yml:Stage Cadrumo packaging smoke evidence
packaging-smoke.yml:Refuse to seal a version the world may already hold bytes under
packaging-smoke.yml:Build the immutable full release cohort
packaging-smoke.yml:Archive the immutable full release cohort
packaging-smoke.yml:Extract the immutable release cohort
packaging-smoke.yml:Install the cohort, run installed oracles, emit the row
publish.yml:Install Python
publish.yml:Emit stable runtime smoke matrix
publish.yml:Build the three distributions
publish.yml:Refuse a distribution over the index file cap
publish.yml:Seal and verify distribution bytes
publish.yml:Verify sealed distribution bytes
publish.yml:Smoke test the built wheels
publish.yml:Refuse a version any destination already owns
publish.yml:Publish to PyPI
python-runtime-compatibility.yml:Validate inventory and emit matrix
python-runtime-compatibility.yml:Enforce future-directive AST policy
python-runtime-compatibility.yml:Build the one immutable release cohort
python-runtime-compatibility.yml:Verify the cohort and record archive digest
python-runtime-compatibility.yml:Run source compatibility probe
python-runtime-compatibility.yml:Hash source compatibility evidence
python-runtime-compatibility.yml:Verify and extract the immutable compatibility cohort
python-runtime-compatibility.yml:Run binary compatibility probe
python-runtime-compatibility.yml:Hash binary compatibility evidence
